about.title: Use this app for yourself
about.intro: Focus Notes is a writing app you run yourself. This site is one person's own copy, with their notes in their own GitHub account. Nothing here is shared with you, and nothing you do here reaches them.
about.step1: 1. Create a free GitHub account, if you don't have one.
about.step2: 2. Make your own copy of the Focus Notes template with Use this template. It's a small repository, not the source code, and there's nothing to build.
about.step3: 3. In your copy, turn on GitHub Pages with GitHub Actions. Your Focus Notes opens at your own address.
about.step4: 4. Write there in your browser right away; those notes stay in that browser. To keep your notes in your own repository, use the desktop app.
about.privacy: There's no server and no account with anyone else. Your copy runs on GitHub Pages, in your account.
